ios.desc:
Turn any event into a fun buzzword bingo game.
Create your own bingo card, invite others, and play together live.
Perfect for family gatherings, New Year’s resolutions, talks, team events, and streams.

* Create custom buzzword bingo cards
* Play together on multiple devices (no account needed)
* Perfect for families, friends, and live audiences
* Smart suggestions to spark ideas
* First bingo wins, simple and fun

- Create Your Game: Create custom Bingo cards to suit any occasion.
- Invite Friends: Bring everyone together for a competitive, fun-filled session.
- Set the Start Date: Lock in the game schedule. Once it begins, the cards are set!
- Real-Time Action: Mark off completed fields as the game unfolds live.

Get ready to play your way to victory. Dive into Event Bingo and transform your happenings into a celebration of fun!

show_hn.title: Show HN: A real-time Bullshit Bingo app for meetings, holidays, family gathering

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built a small iOS app for playing Bullshit / Event Bingo together in real time, originally as a way to survive long company meetings.
More recently, I noticed people using it during the holidays for family gatherings, which I didn’t really plan for.

How it works:

Everyone joins from their own device
You can create your own bingo fields (corporate buzzwords, family clichés, etc.)
Players join via an invite link
The game syncs live, so wins are detected instantly
Works both in-person and fully remote

Design goals:
No accounts
No ads
No tracking-heavy analytics
It’s still small and pretty simple, but engagement has been surprisingly good when people use it for actual events.
I’d love your feedback. I also have an Android version, but I’m currently missing enough test users to publish it on the Play Store.

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6742661122

(Just for fun, I made a bingo card for this post itself: https://event-bingo.web.app/join?id=YWg9qTGcSPClsOKvr36fJA )

Thanks!
